topic: Five ways brands make it worse

slides.headline: Five ways brands make a bad Reddit thread worse
Replying from the brand account.
slides.body: Defensive company replies become the next screenshot.

slides.headline: Alt accounts and upvotes.
slides.body: Vote manipulation breaks Reddit's rules, and users love exposing it.

slides.headline: Public legal threats.
slides.body: Nothing gets a thread more attention than a lawyer's letter posted in it.

slides.headline: Leaning on moderators.
slides.body: Volunteers don't respond well to pressure from companies.

slides.headline: Messaging the poster.
slides.body: Expect your message to be posted, word for word.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
